{{Quote|That's why you're such a softie about the dragon? Because it can make you money?''"<br />"''What other possible value could any creature have?|Han Solo and Nal Kenuun regarding Urgiluu|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Urgiluu''' was a baby [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] owned by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Nal Kenuun]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Kenuun's unusual devotion to the creature&mdash;at odds with his typically cold demeanor&mdash;was well known within his community, to the point that others laughed at him behind his back. Although his contemporaries believed he genuinely cared for the animal, Kenuun was in fact more interested in harvesting the valuable [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearl]] forming inside its [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary]] gain.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] captured Urgiluu and threatened to harm her after Kenuun attempted to seize her companions [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[X-7]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] secretly using the alias Tobin Elad. Fearing that damage to the pearl would reduce its value, Kenuun agreed to Organa's demands, leading to Urgiluu's release.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Haven't you heard Everyone knows that Kenuun loves nothing in this galaxy except his baby krayt dragon. The whole planet's laughing about it behind his back. Of course, the last one foolish enough to laugh in front of him learned his lesson.|Haari Ikreme Beeerd about Nal Kenuun|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:LeiaOrgana-TSS.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Princess Leia Organa, who took Urgiluu hostage]]
Urgiluu was a young [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] owned by [[Nal Kenuun]], a powerful and feared [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Known for his cold-hearted and cruel nature, Kenuun's open affection toward the creature stood in stark contrast to his usual behavior. This contradiction became a source of amusement among his rivals, who mocked him privately. The ridicule eventually escalated to the point where Kenuun orchestrated the [[Death/Legends|death]] of an individual&mdash;and the individual's entire family&mdash;for openly laughing in his presence about his fascination with the creature.<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> Urgiluu was taken hostage by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. She threatened to harm the krayt dragon in order to force Kenuun to release her comrades&mdash;[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[X-7]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] operating under the alias Tobin Elad&mdash;whom Kenuun sought to capture for the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their heads. Fearing that any injury to Urgiluu might damage the precious [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearl]] inside her [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] and reduce its [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary]] worth, Kenuun reluctantly agreed to Organa's terms and quickly escorted the Rebels back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', after which Urgiluu was released unharmed.<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You must be careful. The pearl forming inside her is extremely delicate&mdash;and any malformations would significantly detract from its value|Nal Kenuun on Urgiluu|<ref name="Target" />}}
Urgiluu was less than a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long from her sharp horns to the tip of the spined tail. She possessed a forked [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] that flicked constantly between her [[Color/Legends|yellowed]] lips. As with all krayt dragons, a pearl was slowly forming in her stomach.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Urgiluu appeared in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
